configuration: 4096 environments, H32, policy batch256, world batch512 x10, same 125000-step parent
timing_scope: Update timers include WM and policy/critic internals plus gradient hooks and EMA; exclude collection, post-update full-state checks, save and evaluation. First update excluded; sum corresponding WM and policy/critic timings, then take median of 9 pairs.
training_segment_scope: From trainer creation completion to final candidate snapshot copy, before whole-clip evaluation; includes replay warmup and final save, excludes capacity probe, simulator/network construction and evaluation.
conclusion: Modest update-time and memory savings in this short test; no score improvement. Single short comparison does not establish long-run convergence or overall wall-clock throughput.
